profile.label: Profile
profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarDescription: Shown next to your name in comments, assignees, and members.
profile.avatarFormats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF.
profile.detailsDescription: Your name appears across the app. Sign in with your username or email.
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, and underscores. 3 to 30 characters.

security.label: Security
security.title: Security
security.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in without a password using Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key.
security.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without a password.
security.deleteWarning: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. This cannot be undone.
security.totpDescription: The code the owner terminal asks for every time it opens (Home -> Terminal).
security.totpPasswordHint: Only asked for when this account has one. Leave blank otherwise.
security.totpSecretHint: In the authenticator app, choose “enter a setup key manually” and paste this.
security.totpDisableFailed: Could not turn off the authenticator app.
security.passkeysElsewhere: Passkeys belong to {host}. Here on the home network Helena signs you in automatically; add new passkeys on {host}.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Connect external accounts to sign in with them or receive notifications there.
accounts.googleDescription: Sign in with your Google account.
accounts.telegramWaiting: Waiting for you to press Start in the bot chat…
accounts.noneAvailable: No service to link is set up on this instance yet. The administrator adds Google sign-in and the Telegram bot under Administrator › Integrations.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How the app looks and behaves for you. Every change saves right away and applies wherever you sign in.

sections.dateAndTimeDescription: Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in the zone you pick here.
sections.navigationDescription: Where the app takes you, and how issues open.
sections.issueSettingsDescription: How the stats and the activity log of an issue start out. Switching them while an issue is open does not change these.
sections.notificationsDescription: Watching an issue brings you its comments and status changes.
sections.shortcutsDescription: Press Change, then the keys you want. Reset takes a shortcut back to the one set for this instance.

preferences.themeDescription: Match system follows your operating system setting.
preferences.languageDescription: The language of the interface, your emails, and the Telegram bot.
preferences.headerLayoutDescription: Single row merges the header and the view tabs, and moves language, theme and account into the sidebar. Classic keeps the header and the view tabs in two rows, with those controls in the header.
preferences.timezoneDescription: Pick the zone you work in.
preferences.issueOpenModeDescription: What happens when you click an issue on a board, table, calendar, or timeline.
preferences.startPageDescription: The section that opens when you enter the app, in your last active project.
preferences.showStatsDescription: Whether the stats section starts expanded when you open an issue.
preferences.statsViewDescription: Compact is one bar with a share per status; Timeline gives each status its own lane on a time axis.
preferences.activityViewDescription: Flat is every entry newest first; Grouped splits the log by the status the issue was in.
preferences.autoWatchDescription: The ones you create, get assigned, comment on, or are mentioned in.
preferences.showChatByDefaultDescription: The chat panel opens with a project page. Close it any time from its header or the chat icon.

thisDevice.title: Push on this device
thisDevice.description: Messages from Helena on this phone or computer, even while Helena is not open.
thisDevice.enabled: Push is on for this device
thisDevice.disabled: Push is off for this device
thisDevice.enableFailed: Push could not be switched on: {error}
thisDevice.testSent: Test sent, it should appear in a moment.

insecure.title: Push needs a secure connection
insecure.body: Browsers allow push only over HTTPS or on localhost. Open Helena at its https address once it is set up.

iosInstall.title: On iPhone and iPad, add Helena to the home screen first
iosInstall.body: In Safari: Share → “Add to Home Screen”. Then open Helena from the home screen and switch push on here (iOS 16.4 or later).

unsupported.title: This browser cannot receive push
unsupported.body: Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

denied.title: Notifications are blocked
denied.body: Allow notifications for this site in the browser's site settings and reload the page.

noKey.title: Push is not set up on this server
noKey.body: The server lacks the key it encrypts with (APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY).

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Each device receives only what is switched on for it.
devices.empty: No device yet. Switch push on above on every device that should receive messages.
devices.resubscribe: Must be switched on again on the device.
devices.gone: The push service no longer knows the device; it was removed.

emergencies.label: Emergencies
emergencies.description: A failing disk or RAID, a failed backup, overheating, a service that stopped. Once when it happens, once when it is fixed.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.description: An agent asks for your approval.

needs-you.label: Needs you
needs-you.description: Sign in again, failed security checks, runs and answers.

agent-replies.label: Agent answers
agent-replies.description: An answer in the chat is ready while you do not have Helena open.
